name: Zhongguo Heilong Chuanshuo
source:
The story centers around Zhong Guolong—a Chinese-French mixed-race Han Chinese football player—and his hilariously absurd romantic adventures with four distinct heroines from ethnic minority backgrounds. All set against the backdrop of a vocational high school? You choose who to pursue!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3910860/Chinese_Black_Dragon_Legend/]Steam[/url]]
